description: Service, runner, routes, auth integration, wiring and trip authorization (tasks.md tasks 8-11): service.ts + mail templates, purgeRunner.ts, session middleware defense + sessionId, routes.ts (reauth, deletion, cron), login/reset/web-fallback restore, composeServices.ts + server.ts wiring via structural ports, docs/hosting.md cron section, effectiveRole interim organizer. Task 10: trips/permissions.ts effectiveRole + RosterMember (pure), trips/effectiveRole.ts resolveEffectiveRole, use in authz.ts assertTripMember, trips/repo.ts lockMembership and composeServices roleOf; effectiveRole.prop.test.ts (Property 10) + role-reader guard + interim-organizer route test.
Task 11 checkpoint: `npm run verify:api` and an end-to-end server.inject walk (reauth, request, login restore, forced due date, purge run); report literal tail.
acceptance_criteria: POST /me/account/deletion/reauth wrong password returns 403 reauth_failed (never 401) and calls recordFailure exactly once; success never calls clearOnSuccess.
Login and reset restore a pending account in grace (accountRestored: true only then); an ineligible account is byte-identical to an unknown email; a reset that loses the purge race changes nothing.
An unrevoked session for a pending user answers 401 through the real adapter SQL.
Purge cron endpoint: 401 without/with another cron's secret, 202 accepted, overlapping 202 in_flight, HEAD 202 empty; runner idle pass issues exactly two statements and no write.
verification: npx vitest run src/services/accountDeletion src/services/auth src/services/photos src/services/trips (in apps/api)
